title: Smart Data Models - ERA ERADIS - TechnicalSpecForInteroperability
description: Technical Specification for Interoperability (era:TechnicalSpecForInteroperability's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Technical Specification for Interoperability Inherits attributes from era:Requirement (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TechnicalSpecForInteroperability'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

section.description: Property. section(s) of the requirement to which individual compliance can be registered by the Appropriate Body Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.
